test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The compound interest of a sum of Rs. 75,000 at a fixed annual rate of interest compounded on an annual basis in 2 years is Rs. 6,120. If the interest is compounded quarterly, what will be the sum of Rs. 1,00,000 received after one year at the same rate of interest (in Rs., up to two places of decimal)?​
solution:
Given:

The compound interest of a sum of Rs. 75,000 at a fixed annual rate of interest compounded on an annual basis in 2 years is Rs. 6,120.

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the interest rate be R%.

According to the question,

75000(1 + R/100)² - 75000 = 6120

⇒ (1 + R/100)2 = (75000 + 6120)/75000

⇒ (1 + R/100)2 = 1.0816

⇒ (1 + R/100)2 = 1.04²

​⇒ 1 + R/100 = 1.04

⇒ R/100 = 1.04 - 1

⇒ R = 4

When the interest is compounded quarterly,

The amount becomes = 100000(1 + {{4over 4} over 100})⁴ × ¹

⇒ 100000(1.01)⁴

⇒ Rs. 104060.40

**∴ The amount becomes Rs. 104060.40.**
